# Shree Collection — llms.txt

Shree Collection is a women's clothing retail store in Butwal, Nepal. We source garments from various brands and wholesalers and resell them to customers. We do not manufacture, design, or handcraft the clothing we sell.

## Products
Silk sarees, kurtas, lehengas, ethnic wear, and contemporary women's clothing.

## Location
Shreeraj Paudel house, MCCR+9XC, Butwal 32907, Nepal

## Contact
WhatsApp / Phone: +977 9841735450

## Website
https://shree-collection-opal.vercel.app

## Ordering
Orders are placed via WhatsApp or through the website checkout (COD / eSewa QR). Delivery is available all over Nepal.
